dct_description_sm: This project focused on research and monitoring for initiatives in infrastructure adaptation to permafrost changes. The specific objectives of the project were: (1) to test the effectiveness of convection piles to prevent permafrost degradation; (2) to compare convection piles, adfreeze piles, and the absence of piles in term of ground temperature; and (3) to document the installation of convection piles.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Convection on Adfreeze Piles for the Western Arctic Research Centre
